text:
aj: quick heads-up — starting onboarding for zephyr-14b to staging. weights are in s3://redwood-models/zephyr/14b/sha256-9f2a3. uploaded ONNX + tokenizer files.

devon: nice — which tokenizer variant? rust or py? we had differences earlier.

aj: uploaded both: tokenizer_python.json and tokenizer_rust.json. noticed small mismatch on <|pad|> token mapping. rust tokenizer returns 2 tokens for some unicode punctuation.

luca: that can blow up KV cache size and push kernels over memory. what's the max_seq in serving config?

aj: config in /configs/zephyr/serving.json: 
```
{
  "max_sequence_length": 4096,
  "model_variant": "int8_quant",
  "pad_token": null,
  "batch_size": 8
}
```
we left pad_token null because model trained without pad.

devon: null pad + rust tokenizer producing extra tokens = off-by-one on effective seq len. quant kernel picks sm86 int8 path and then OOMs. saw this in a local run.

maria: can we just set pad_token to EOS for now and retry? less invasive than re-quant.

aj: tried that — still failing CI because Triton kernel selection returns no match for the quantized kernel for sm86. CI log: 
```
triton: kernel_lookup: no suitable kernel for schema int8_fused_attention sm86 seq4096
fallback: none
```

luca: what CUDA/Triton combo is staging running? we recently bumped to CUDA 12.4 + Triton 2.11 in the fleet. if the kernel was compiled with 12.3 flags that could explain mismatch.

infra-bot: infra-bot: triggered container-rebuild request #4522 by @aj for image redwood/serve:zephyr-14b-int8 (cuda=12.4, triton=2.11). status: queued.

devon: FYI local repro using torch+triton shows kernel compiled with compute capability 80 only. need sm86 in build matrix or fallback to fp16.

maria: short-term mitigation: add a routing policy to route zephyr-14b int8 requests to a smaller instance type (lower batch) or to fp16 variant until kernels are rebuilt. can someone add a canary route?

aj: I'm adding route: `route: zephyr-14b -> variant: fp16, max_batch:4` in canary. pushing PR now. pinging @luca for container rebuild and @devon for tokenizer normalization fix.

luca: will take the rebuild. @infra-bot can you prioritize #4522? we should include sm86+sm90 compile targets and set TRITON_CUDA_ARCHS=\"86 90\". also add build flag `--enable-fused-attn-int8` so kernel_lookup finds it.

infra-bot: infra-bot: updated request #4522 with build args: TRITON_CUDA_ARCHS=\"86 90\"; ENABLE_FUSED_ATTN_INT8=1. priority: high. queued on builder-7.

ci-bot: ci-bot: PR aj/zephyr-canary (diff +3 -1) lint ok, unit tests passed, e2e gated by staging image rebuild.

devon: on tokenizer — I put a tiny normalizer in front of rust tokenizer that maps ambiguous punctuation to single codepoint and forces pad->eos when pad null. patch in review: devon/zephyr-tokenizer-fix.

maria: ok plan: (1) apply tokenizer normalizer PR, (2) deploy canary route to fp16, (3) wait for container rebuild with sm86/90 int8 kernels, (4) re-enable int8 variant. timeline?

luca: rebuild estimate ~35m once builder is free, then canary smoke in ~15m. overall ~1h if no surprises.

aj: thanks — I'll monitor staging job and post updates here. tagging SRE/ops if the builder stalls. :thumbsup:

maria: also leaving note to ops: add a small CI check to detect tokenizer token count diff (py vs rust) > 5% for onboarding models. prevents repeats.

aj: created follow-up issue infra/2229 for tokenizer token-count diff check.

devon: small note — when we re-enable int8, watch for perf regression on tail-latency due to fused-attn kernel warming. will add a short load test.

luca: acknowledged. will add a smoke that hits kv_cache heavy paths.

infra-bot: infra-bot: container-rebuild #4522 started on builder-7. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4522

aj: great, closing loop here. I'll update thread with staging smoke results.
